question: In which year was the Indian Football Association established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1893.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Football Association, **abbreviated as IFA, is the organization that administers association football in the state of West Bengal, India.
 
• It is the oldest Football Association in India and was founded in **1893.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The All India Football Federation is the governing body of football in India under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• Formed in 1935 founded at Darbhanga, the federation was one of the founding members of the Asian Football Confederation, the overseer of football in Asia.
